scope: Latest interpolation/parameter-reader Worker optimization: five anchored source/test files and their direct relevance cone. Older unrelated dirty work was preserved.
overallRisk: Scoped correctness defects were reproduced and fixed; no remaining P0/P1/P2 findings in the reviewed cone.

findings.title: Sampling-policy identity depended on enumerable metadata
findings.risk: Valid inherited or non-enumerable policies could share a grid point with a different effective precision/tolerance; unrelated circular metadata could throw during preparation.
findings.cause: Object.entries(sampling) missed effective inherited/non-enumerable fields and serialized unrelated metadata.
findings.fix: Use only the four effective policy fields in a fixed tuple.
findings.observedBefore: 6 regression cases failed; float32 sampling returned 0.7 instead of 0.699999988079071; circular metadata threw TypeError.

findings.title: Caller serialization hooks changed parameter/grid identities
findings.risk: Valid programmatic arrays with toJSON could alias different axes or keyform grids and produce wrong samples.
findings.cause: JSON.stringify was applied directly to caller-owned arrays for reader identity, grid fingerprints, and corner indexing. Corner indexing predates the latest optimization but belongs to the same affected call path.
findings.fix: Build reader keys from the actual indexed axes; serialize owned parameter-id arrays; copy numeric arrays only when they expose toJSON. Ordinary numeric arrays preserve their existing preparation path.
findings.tradeoff: Conditional copying avoids the measured cold metadata preparation overhead of copying every keyform array.
findings.observedBefore: Reader returned [3] instead of [15]; keyform cases returned 0 or 1 instead of 0.5. All 3 cases failed before their corresponding fixes.

passes.result: Full P0-P4 review; two P2 causes reproduced with 7 failing regression cases; fixed.
Fresh full review; the remaining keyform serialization path of P2-2 reproduced with 2 failing cases; fixed.
Fresh full review and resource/scaling checks; unconditional array copies added preparation overhead, so restrict copying to caller serialization hooks.
Fresh behavior/refactoring/naming review after the conditional-copy refinement; final complete checks, resource probes, numeric/pixel comparisons and ABBA playback measurements pass.

perspectives.behavior: Reviewed interpolation precision, tolerance, repeats, step/continuous points, rest fallbacks, channel sharing, raw parameter changes, immutable binding/document contracts, Worker initialization, JS/Wasm callers, recovery and cache ownership. Local typed-input helpers add no new remote side effects or trust boundary. Public playback bindings retain their existing parser validation and three-axis contract. Converter grid sampling also exercised at five axes.
perspectives.refactoring: Reviewed coupling, testability, state derivation, pure computation and cache boundaries. No new production test hooks, runtime options, dependencies or UI paths. No verified structural P3 findings.
perspectives.namingAndStructure: Role-based names, existing module ownership, TypeScript/comment conventions reviewed. Changed production files remain below 600 lines. No verified P3/P4 findings.
